name: ChemDataExtractor dye-sensitized solar-cell devices
description: Literature-extracted dye-sensitized solar-cell records with device performance and component-material information.
version: Figshare 13516220 v1; independently counted JSONL release
count_scope: Downloaded Figshare v1 JSON archive has 26,930 Elsevier + 14,930 RSC documents, with 41,860 distinct internal IDs. Paper instead states 41,680 devices and 475,045 attribute sub-entries.

sources.title: Perovskite- and Dye-Sensitized Solar-Cell Device Databases Auto-generated Using ChemDataExtractor
sources.evidence: Describes a DSC device corpus with 475,045 property/material sub-entries; article device count is 41,680. Data contain cognate photovoltaic properties and component materials.

sources.title: Dye-sensitized Solar Cell Database v1
sources.evidence: Deposit declares MIT. Downloaded dsc_json.zip independently contains 41,860 JSONL documents with distinct internal IDs across Elsevier/RSC files.

caveats: Records represent reported photovoltaic devices, not unique chemical compositions or periodic crystal structures.
Raw, standardized and algebraically derived device quantities coexist; retain calculated-value flags and irradiance/area assumptions.
Multiple reports of the same material/device can occur; no global physical-device deduplication established.
JSON and MongoDB releases are alternate formats of the same population.
Published 41,680 device count disagrees with the 41,860-document archive recount; this record uses the archive and does not silently equate them.
DSCs include molecular dyes, electrolytes and engineered layers; this is adjacent to crystal-structure data.

name: ChemDataExtractor perovskite solar-cell devices
description: Literature-extracted perovskite solar-device performance and component-material records.
version: Figshare 13516238 v1; independently counted JSONL release
count_scope: Downloaded Figshare v1 archive has 8,259 Elsevier + 7,559 RSC documents with distinct internal IDs; paper reports 185,836 property/material sub-entries for these 15,818 devices.

sources.title: Perovskite- and Dye-Sensitized Solar-Cell Device Databases Auto-generated Using ChemDataExtractor
sources.evidence: Separately describes PSC and DSC corpora; the PSC corpus contains 185,836 attribute sub-entries organized into 15,818 photovoltaic records.

sources.title: Perovskite Solar Cell Database v1
sources.evidence: Deposit declares MIT. Independently parsed PSC JSONL files contain 15,818 documents and distinct internal IDs.

caveats: Records represent reported photovoltaic devices, not unique chemical compositions or periodic crystal structures.
Raw, standardized and algebraically derived device quantities coexist; retain calculated-value flags and irradiance/area assumptions.
Multiple reports of the same material/device can occur; no global physical-device deduplication established.
JSON and MongoDB releases are alternate formats of the same population.
Distinct extraction lineage from the manually compiled Perovskite Database Project, with potentially overlapping source papers/devices. Do not add as independent unique materials.

name: Text-mined perovskite solar-device fabrication attributes
description: Article-level extraction of perovskite-device layer materials, architecture and fabrication details.
count_scope: Figshare v2 JSON RECORDS list contains 3,164 entries with 3,164 unique source DOIs and 30 fields. Paper Phase I subset contains 1,505 records; the final population includes Phase II expansion.

sources.title: Auto-generating a database on the fabrication details of perovskite solar devices
sources.evidence: Data Records identifies 30 attributes; after filtering, 1,505 Phase I records and 3,164 combined final records were retained.

sources.title: device_attributes_combined.json v2
sources.evidence: Data deposit declares CC0; downloaded JSON independently contains 3,164 records and unique DOIs.

caveats: One record is linked to a paper and is not a count of every separately fabricated/tested device in that paper.
Phase I intentionally reuses source papers represented in the existing Perovskite Database Project; Phase II adds an independent source-paper expansion. Counts are not disjoint.
Current extraction can return one HTL and one ETL; double-layer transport materials may be incompletely represented.
Composition/layer labels and deposition parameters do not provide periodic atomic coordinates or guarantee a unique phase.
This fabrication corpus is distinct from the CDE photovoltaic-performance corpus; source overlap remains possible.

name: Optical emissivity curves for heterogeneous engineered designs
description: Figure-extracted emissivity curves with materials, geometry and experimental/computational method metadata.
count_scope: 153 one-curve JSON records extracted from 176 figures in 64 papers; source figures contain 550 curves, so this is a successfully extracted subset.

sources.title: Optical emissivity dataset of multi-material heterogeneous designs generated with automated figure extraction
sources.evidence: Data Records defines one JSON per curve, containing material, geometry, method, axes units, legend and quality score; 153 curves retrieved from 550 total source curves.

sources.title: Emissivity data release v1
sources.evidence: Figshare declares CC0; downloaded emissivity_dataset.zip independently contains 153 curve JSON files. Payload explicitly identifies calculated as well as experimental curves.

caveats: Curves describe engineered films, multilayers, composites and other geometries, not unique bulk crystals.
Experimental and simulated curves coexist; preserve data_type and modeling/measurement method.
The extraction retains only colored curves that the pipeline recovered; reported recall is 27% over all source curves and 55% over colored curves.
Quality scores flag curve gaps/conflicting points; digitized points are not original instrument output.
Geometry keywords are not full atomistic structures; do not merge this release with EKHI as disjoint materials.

name: Self-cleaning coating material and property corpora
description: Text-mined coating-material dictionaries, property-value groups and stability/durability sentiment statistics.
count_scope: Release includes 38 JSON tables from a 39,011-paper corpus. Tables cover six overlapping function/property corpora, material dictionaries/frequencies, grouped numerical values and sentiment summaries; no reconciled unique observation/material total is asserted.

sources.title: Automatically Generated Datasets: Present and Potential Self-Cleaning Coating Materials
sources.evidence: Data Records describes four output formats: material statistics, dictionary, numerical self-cleaning/optical values, and stability/durability sentiment. The 39,011 figure is source-paper count.

sources.title: Self-cleaning coating data release v2
sources.evidence: Figshare declares CC BY 4.0. Downloaded RAR contains 38 JSON tables; inspected value tables group each numeric value with lists of DOI/material pairs.

caveats: 39,011 papers, 38 JSON files, unique numeric-value groups and individual DOI/material pairs are different units; none is promoted as a unique crystal count.
Hydrophilic, hydrophobic, oleophobic, omniphobic, photocatalytic and self-cleaning corpora can overlap; do not sum them as independent materials.
Material names may refer to polymers, composites, coatings or substrates; no atomic crystal structures.
Automated value/material pairing and sentiment labels require source-context checks; sentiment is not a measured durability property.
Article states data release omits original-text excerpts; source DOI provenance remains available.
